headlines.text: Nvidia confirms Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO effective immediately amid affair scandal; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
Apple chip chief Johny Srouji emerges as potential candidate to replace Huang as Nvidia's next CEO
Nvidia shares swing as much as 6-12% as Huang's abrupt exit rattles the AI trade, pressuring S&P 500 and Nasdaq
AMD jumps ~3%, Broadcom surges as much as 6% as investors rotate into Nvidia's AI-chip rivals amid leadership chaos
Red-hot core CPI for a third straight month keeps December Fed rate-hike odds elevated, pressuring equity futures
Analysts warn Nvidia's leaderless transition risks shareholder returns, citing history of CEO exits without succession plans
